name: Resistance Cloak +1
description: Standard D&D 3.5e cloak of resistance: +1 resistance bonus on saving throws (not AC).

modifiers.notes: Does not increase AC under standard D&D 3.5e rules.

name: Ring of Protection +1
description: Grants a +1 deflection bonus to AC.

name: Ring of Water Walking
description: Allows the wearer to walk on water.

name: Ring of Freedom of Movement
description: Protects the wearer from effects that impede movement, as described by the D&D 3.5e item.

name: Gauntlets of Ogre Power
description: These magical gauntlets grant a +2 enhancement bonus to Strength while equipped.

name: Boots of Speed
description: Haste for up to 10 rounds per day. Track remaining rounds manually; this item does not automatically modify attack rolls or AC in the app.

modifiers.notes: Track the 10 rounds/day manually. Configure any desired effects separately.

name: Lavender Ioun Stone
description: Immunity to spells of 4th level and below, as specified for Bax’s item.

modifiers.notes: Immunity to spells of 4th level or lower.

name: Necklace of Fireballs
description: Necklace of fireballs. Track remaining beads/charges and the bead type separately; details not specified yet.

name: +2 Frost Dwarven Waraxe
description: Dwarven waraxe with +2 enhancement to attack rolls, +3 total damage bonus as specified for Bax, plus 1d6 cold damage from frost. Critical multiplier ×3.

modifiers.notes: Total weapon damage bonus as specified for Bax.
Frost enchantment adds +1d6 cold damage; add this dice damage separately when rolling.

name: Composite Longbow (+3 Strength Rating)
description: Composite longbow with a +3 Strength rating. This is the bow’s rated Strength bonus, not a +3 magical enhancement; it can apply up to +3 Strength bonus to damage.

name: Potion of Cure Light Wounds
description: Heals 1d8+1 hit points. Caster level 1. Market price: 50 gp.

name: Potion of Endure Elements
description: Protects the drinker from hot or cold environmental conditions. Caster level 1. Market price: 50 gp.

name: Potion of Hide from Animals
description: Animals cannot perceive the drinker unless they actively search or detect the drinker. Caster level 1. Market price: 50 gp.

name: Potion of Hide from Undead
description: Undead creatures have difficulty detecting the drinker. Caster level 1. Market price: 50 gp.

name: Potion of Jump
description: Grants a +10 enhancement bonus on Jump checks. Caster level 1. Market price: 50 gp.

name: Potion of Mage Armour
description: Grants a +4 armour bonus to AC. Caster level 1. Market price: 50 gp.

name: Potion of Magic Fang
description: One natural weapon gains a +1 enhancement bonus on attack and damage rolls. Caster level 1. Market price: 50 gp.

name: Potion of Pass without Trace
description: The drinker leaves no tracks and cannot be tracked by mundane means. Caster level 1. Market price: 50 gp.

name: Potion of Protection from Chaos
description: Grants +2 deflection AC and +2 resistance on saves against chaotic creatures, and blocks mental control and summoned creatures as the spell. Caster level 1. Market price: 50 gp.

name: Potion of Protection from Evil
description: Grants +2 deflection AC and +2 resistance on saves against evil creatures, and blocks mental control and summoned creatures as the spell. Caster level 1. Market price: 50 gp.

name: Potion of Protection from Good
description: Grants +2 deflection AC and +2 resistance on saves against good creatures, and blocks mental control and summoned creatures as the spell. Caster level 1. Market price: 50 gp.

name: Potion of Protection from Law
description: Grants +2 deflection AC and +2 resistance on saves against lawful creatures, and blocks mental control and summoned creatures as the spell. Caster level 1. Market price: 50 gp.

name: Potion of Remove Fear
description: Suppresses fear effects and grants a +4 morale bonus on saves against fear for 10 minutes. Caster level 1. Market price: 50 gp.

name: Potion of Sanctuary
description: Opponents must make a Will save to attack the drinker; ends if the drinker attacks. Caster level 1. Market price: 50 gp.

name: Potion of Shield of Faith +2
description: Grants a +2 deflection bonus to AC. Caster level 3. Market price: 50 gp.

name: Potion of Enlarge Person
description: Increases the drinker one size category, granting the spell's size, Strength, Dexterity, attack, AC and reach changes. Caster level 1. Market price: 250 gp.

name: Potion of Reduce Person
description: Reduces the drinker one size category, granting the spell's size, Strength, Dexterity, attack, AC and reach changes. Caster level 1. Market price: 250 gp.

name: Potion of Aid
description: Grants 1d8 temporary hit points and a +1 morale bonus on attack rolls and saves against fear. Caster level 3. Market price: 300 gp.

name: Potion of Barkskin +2
description: Grants a +2 enhancement bonus to natural armour. Caster level 3. Market price: 300 gp.

name: Potion of Bear's Endurance
description: Grants a +4 enhancement bonus to Constitution. Caster level 3. Market price: 300 gp.

name: Potion of Blur
description: Attacks against the drinker have a 20% miss chance. Caster level 3. Market price: 300 gp.

name: Potion of Bull's Strength
description: Grants a +4 enhancement bonus to Strength. Caster level 3. Market price: 300 gp.

name: Potion of Cat's Grace
description: Grants a +4 enhancement bonus to Dexterity. Caster level 3. Market price: 300 gp.

name: Potion of Cure Moderate Wounds
description: Heals 2d8+3 hit points. Caster level 3. Market price: 300 gp.

name: Potion of Darkvision
description: Grants darkvision out to 60 feet. Caster level 3. Market price: 300 gp.

name: Potion of Delay Poison
description: Temporarily suppresses the effects of poison for 3 hours. Caster level 3. Market price: 300 gp.

name: Potion of Eagle's Splendour
description: Grants a +4 enhancement bonus to Charisma. Caster level 3. Market price: 300 gp.

name: Potion of Fox's Cunning
description: Grants a +4 enhancement bonus to Intelligence. Caster level 3. Market price: 300 gp.

name: Potion of Invisibility
description: Makes the drinker invisible until the spell ends or the drinker attacks. Caster level 3. Market price: 300 gp.

name: Potion of Lesser Restoration
description: Dispels magical ability penalties or repairs 1d4 points of temporary ability damage to one ability score. Caster level 3. Market price: 300 gp.

name: Potion of Levitate
description: Allows the drinker to move up or down through the air; horizontal movement requires pushing or pulling against a surface. Caster level 3. Market price: 300 gp.

name: Potion of Misdirection
description: Misleads divination spells that detect the drinker's alignment, creature type or similar information. Caster level 3. Market price: 300 gp.

name: Potion of Owl's Wisdom
description: Grants a +4 enhancement bonus to Wisdom. Caster level 3. Market price: 300 gp.

name: Potion of Protection from Arrows
description: Grants damage reduction 10/magic against ranged weapon attacks, up to 10 points per caster level (maximum 100). Caster level 3. Market price: 300 gp.

name: Potion of Remove Paralysis
description: Frees the drinker from paralysis, slow effects and related conditions as the spell. Caster level 3. Market price: 300 gp.

name: Potion of Resist Energy (10)
description: Choose acid, cold, electricity, fire or sonic when created; grants resistance 10 to that energy type. Caster level 3. Market price: 300 gp.

name: Potion of Shield of Faith +3
description: Grants a +3 deflection bonus to AC. Caster level 6. Market price: 300 gp.

name: Potion of Spider Climb
description: Grants the ability to climb and travel on vertical surfaces and ceilings. Caster level 3. Market price: 300 gp.

name: Potion of Undetectable Alignment
description: Conceals the drinker's alignment from divination effects. Caster level 3. Market price: 300 gp.

name: Potion of Cure Serious Wounds
description: Heals 3d8+5 hit points. Caster level 5. Market price: 750 gp.

name: Potion of Displacement
description: Attacks against the drinker have a 50% miss chance. Caster level 5. Market price: 750 gp.

name: Potion of Fly
description: Grants a fly speed of 60 feet with good manoeuvrability. Caster level 5. Market price: 750 gp.

name: Potion of Gaseous Form
description: Transforms the drinker into a gaseous form with the spell's movement and defensive properties. Caster level 5. Market price: 750 gp.

name: Potion of Haste
description: Grants the haste spell's extra attack, speed increase, attack bonus and AC bonus for 5 rounds. Caster level 5. Market price: 750 gp.

name: Potion of Heroism
description: Grants a +2 morale bonus on attack rolls, saves and skill checks. Caster level 5. Market price: 750 gp.

name: Potion of Neutralize Poison
description: Detoxifies the drinker, removing poison and protecting against further poison for 10 minutes. Caster level 5. Market price: 750 gp.

name: Potion of Nondetection
description: Makes the drinker difficult to detect with divination spells. Caster level 5. Market price: 750 gp.

name: Potion of Protection from Energy
description: Choose acid, cold, electricity, fire or sonic when created; absorbs 60 points of damage from that energy type. Caster level 5. Market price: 750 gp.

name: Potion of Rage
description: Grants the drinker the effects of rage for 5 rounds. Caster level 5. Market price: 750 gp.

name: Potion of Remove Blindness/Deafness
description: Cures blindness or deafness. Caster level 5. Market price: 750 gp.

name: Potion of Remove Curse
description: Frees the drinker from curses as the spell. Caster level 5. Market price: 750 gp.

name: Potion of Remove Disease
description: Cures all diseases affecting the drinker. Caster level 5. Market price: 750 gp.

name: Potion of Tongues
description: Allows the drinker to speak and understand any language. Caster level 5. Market price: 750 gp.

name: Potion of Water Breathing
description: Allows the drinker to breathe underwater. Caster level 5. Market price: 750 gp.

name: Potion of Water Walk
description: Allows the drinker to walk on liquid surfaces. Caster level 5. Market price: 750 gp.

name: Potion of Good Hope
description: Grants a +2 morale bonus on attack rolls, damage rolls, saves and skill checks. Caster level 7. Market price: 1,050 gp.

name: Bedroll

name: Blanket, Winter
description: 5 sp; 3 lb. A thick blanket for warmth while resting.

name: Rope, Hempen (50 ft.)
description: 1 gp; 10 lb. 50 feet of strong hemp rope.

name: Rope, Silk (50 ft.)
description: 10 gp; 5 lb. Lighter, stronger silk rope.

name: Waterskin
description: 1 gp; 4 lb. when full (1 lb. empty). Holds enough water for one Medium creature's daily needs.

description: 5 sp; 1 lb. Food for one person for one day.

name: Backpack
description: 2 gp; 2 lb. An ordinary adventurer's backpack.

name: Belt Pouch
description: 1 gp; 1/2 lb. Small pouch for coins and small items.

name: Sack
description: 1 sp; 1/2 lb. A simple cloth sack.

name: Pouch
description: 1 gp; 1/2 lb. Small pouch for carrying components or valuables.

name: Handy Haversack
description: 2,000 gp; 5 lb. Wondrous item. Its extradimensional storage keeps contents organised and makes retrieving an item stored in it a move action that does not provoke attacks of opportunity. The central compartment holds 8 cubic feet (up to 80 lb.); each side pouch holds 2 cubic feet (up to 20 lb.).

name: Arrows (20)
description: 1 gp; 3 lb. A standard bundle of 20 arrows for bows. Stored in a quiver.

name: Crossbow Bolts (10)
description: 1 gp; 1 lb. A standard bundle of 10 bolts for crossbows.

name: Quiver
description: 1 gp; 1 lb. Holds up to 20 arrows.

name: Crossbow Bolt Case
description: 1 gp; 1 lb. A case for carrying crossbow bolts.

name: Sling Bullets (10)
description: 1 sp; 5 lb. Ten metal bullets for a sling.

name: Flint and Steel
description: 1 gp. Used to light a fire; lighting a torch takes a full-round action, and other fires take at least as long.

name: Torch
description: 1 cp; 1 lb. Burns for 1 hour, clearly illuminating a 20-foot radius and providing shadowy illumination for another 20 feet.

name: Hooded Lantern
description: 7 gp; 2 lb. Provides normal illumination in a 30-foot radius and increases the radius of shadowy illumination by 30 feet; burns one flask of oil for 6 hours.

name: Oil (1-pint Flask)
description: 1 sp; 1 lb. Fuels a lamp or lantern; can also be used as a splash weapon.

name: Tindertwig
description: 1 gp; —. A alchemical fire-lighting stick that ignites when struck; burns for 1d2 rounds.

name: Crowbar
description: 2 gp; 5 lb. Grants a +2 circumstance bonus on Strength checks made to force open a door or chest.

name: Grappling Hook
description: 1 gp; 4 lb. A hooked device used with rope for climbing or securing lines.

name: Hammer
description: 5 sp; 2 lb. A basic hammer.

name: Pitons (10)
description: 1 gp; 5 lb. Ten iron spikes used to secure ropes or aid climbing.

name: Climber's Kit
description: 80 gp; 5 lb. Includes special pitons, boot tips, gloves and a harness; grants a +2 circumstance bonus on Climb checks.

name: Healer's Kit
description: 50 gp; 1 lb. Contains bandages, salves and splints; has 10 uses and grants a +2 circumstance bonus on Heal checks.

name: Mess Kit
description: 2 sp; 1 lb. Basic utensils and a small plate or bowl for preparing and eating meals.

name: Soap (1 lb.)
description: 5 sp; 1 lb. Basic cleaning soap.

name: Winter Bedroll
description: 3 gp; 5 lb. A warmer bedroll suitable for cold-weather travel (campaign variant item).

name: Tent
description: 10 gp; 20 lb. A simple tent providing shelter for one or more travellers, depending on size.

name: Fishing Net (25 sq. ft.)
description: 4 gp; 5 lb. A net used for fishing or catching small creatures.

name: Iron Pot
description: 5 sp; 10 lb. A cooking pot suitable for preparing meals over a fire.

name: Shovel
description: 2 gp; 8 lb. Used for digging.

name: Chalk (10 pieces)
description: 1 sp; negligible weight. Ten pieces of chalk for marking routes and surfaces.

name: Map or Scroll Case
description: 1 gp; 1/2 lb. Protects maps, papers or scrolls from damage.

name: Amulet of Natural Armour +1
description: Grants a +1 enhancement bonus to the wearer's natural armour bonus, increasing AC. Natural armour enhancement bonuses do not stack with other enhancement bonuses to natural armour.

modifiers.notes: +1 enhancement bonus to natural armour; does not stack with another enhancement bonus to natural armour.

name: Eversmoking Bottle
description: Wondrous item; 5,400 gp; 1 lb. Removing the stopper produces a thick cloud of smoke that fills a 50-foot cube per round. The bottle takes 10 minutes to fill the full volume; smoke persists for 10 minutes after the bottle is stoppered. The smoke obscures vision like a fog cloud and can be dispersed by strong wind.
